prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 连续高行 · 发布计划 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "阶段" · longest unbreakable word 32px · one-line width 67px
  col 2: header "时间" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 44px
  col 3: header "负责人" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "内容" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 736px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示发布计划各阶段的时间、负责人和执行内容，便于跟踪从冻结到复盘的进度。","reading":"读者先按时间和阶段纵向扫描，再横向核对负责人及具体安排；灰度阶段的长内容会形成较高的行，可在这些行内容纳必要的换行。","groups":["阶段和时间共同标识发布进程，适合相邻扫描。","负责人和内容共同说明每个阶段由谁执行、要做什么；内容列承担主要的叙述空间。"],"keep_intact":["日期如 05-06 应保持完整。","负责人姓名应保持完整。","灰度比例中的数字与百分号应保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["灰度阶段名称可在文字与比例之间换行。","内容列中的长句可按自然语义换行；较短的内容宜保持单行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [88, 65, 67, 499] · table 720×325px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 60, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [88, 65, 65, 501] · table 720×348px · row heights [60, 36, 60, 60, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [80, 65, 67, 507] · table 720×325px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 60, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"表头、日期、姓名和阶段名称均保持完整；三个灰度阶段的长内容各占两行，行与行之间有清楚的节奏，短内容也保持单行。","problems":"长内容的部分换行落在词语内部，如“指标”和“命中率”被拆到两行；第二行相对较短。","cause":"内容列为499px，文本可用宽度为478px，恰好在这些词语中间触发换行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"日期、姓名和阶段名称保持完整，内容列比r1A略宽，灰度阶段仍各占两行。","problems":"“负责人”表头被拆成两行，抬高整个表头，并削弱表头的横向一致性；内容列增加的空间没有带来足以抵消这一问题的改善。","cause":"负责人列为65px，文本可用宽度仅44px，小于表头所需的46px。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"所有表头、日期和姓名保持完整；内容列较宽，长内容仍各占两行。","problems":"“灰度10%”和“灰度50%”在文字与比例之间换行，阶段列出现参差，读者纵向比较灰度比例时需要多看一行；这些换行没有减少行高。","cause":"阶段列为80px，文本可用宽度为59px，小于最长阶段名称所需的67px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A","widths":[88,65,67,499],"change":"以r1A作为基准：保留完整的阶段名称和单行表头，便于与调整内容列后的方案比较。"},{"name":"r2B","widths":[88,65,68,498],"change":"负责人列增加1px，给表头留出少量余地；内容列减少1px，观察长句的换行位置是否更自然。"},{"name":"r2C","widths":[88,66,67,498],"change":"时间列增加1px，为日期留出少量余地；内容列减少1px，同时保持阶段和负责人列的完整性。"}]}
